noAnchorGaps.concept: The growing volume bars in the sub-panel — the literal object the beat teaches.
noAnchorGaps.quote: look at the bars growing taller as price makes new highs
noAnchorGaps.why: move uptrend exposes only price-point anchors (start/high1/hl1/hh1/hl2/hh2/flipLevel) and a flipLevel level — no anchor on the volume sub-panel. The existing marker at hh2 'rising volume = strong, bullish' already labels the meaning on a valid point anchor.

noAnchorGaps.concept: The shrinking volume bars — the object taught here.
noAnchorGaps.quote: the bars shrink as price climbs
noAnchorGaps.why: move uptrend exposes no volume-panel anchor; same chart value as up-strong so accumulation carries the hh2 marker. This beat's marker at hh2 'fading volume = weak, reversal risk' already labels the meaning. Do not invent a volume-bar anchor.

noAnchorGaps.concept: Rising volume during the fall (heavy, committed selling) — the volume-bar object.
noAnchorGaps.quote: Price is falling while volume is rising — heavy, committed selling
noAnchorGaps.why: move downtrend exposes only price-point anchors (start/low1/lh1/ll1/lh2/ll2/flipLevel) — no volume-panel anchor. The existing marker at ll2 'rising volume = strong selling' already carries the meaning on a valid point anchor.

noAnchorGaps.concept: Drying-up volume signalling a possible nearby bottom.
noAnchorGaps.quote: volume is drying up. The selling is losing conviction
noAnchorGaps.why: move downtrend exposes no volume-panel anchor and no 'bottom' point anchor (only ll2, the last lower-low, which is already marked). This beat's marker at ll2 'fading volume = sellers exhausting' already labels the meaning. Do not invent an anchor.

notes: Confirmed the auditor's proposal in full. The entire lesson's teaching object is the volume sub-panel bars (rising vs fading), which neither uptrend nor downtrend exposes an anchor for — both moves only surface price-swing points. All four existing markers are valid: hh2 (uptrend) and ll2 (downtrend) are real point anchors, markers are the correct kind for point anchors, and labels/styles/places match the say (above for uptrend, below for downtrend). The chart-value accumulation is correct: up-strong/up-weak share 'uptrend' (markers accumulate), down-strong/down-weak share 'downtrend' (resets at down-strong, then accumulates). No anchorable gap was missed; nothing to add or fix. CONCEPT beats intro/why/recap are text-only and out of scope.
